title:
Any entity type mixing WeatherAware will have its "beforeCreate" and "beforeUpdate" claimed
by this type. To create "weatherStation" and persist it in the entity that mixes WeatherAware
has to pass in the annotation "weather". If the "weather" annotation does not exist, the
"beforeCreate" and "beforeUpdate" will return the same object back without creating the
weatherStation on it.
name: WeatherAware
